title: The Concept Is Not the State
subtitle: what Anthropic’s emotion paper actually found
body: A constructionist critique of emotion-representation work in AI interpretability, grounded in Lisa Feldman Barrett’s theory: finding a direction that encodes an emotion concept is not the same as finding the state, and conflating them repeats — inside model internals — the category error affective science spent two decades unwinding. Where the neuroscience training and the AI-safety work meet on the page.
